plan.claim: Arrival delays bunch just under fifteen minutes for some carriers, more than at placebo thresholds.
plan.estimator: Per carrier, counts by whole minute of arrival delay; a cubic fit to the log counts within twenty five minutes of the threshold, excluding five minutes either side; excess mass below plus missing mass above.
plan.family: Every reporting carrier in the test years, Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.05.
plan.interval: Not an interval: a p value against placebos, and the excess mass as a share.
plan.simulator: False positive rate on clean carriers and power on planted carriers (recovery study).
plan.split: choose on 2015 to 2022, report on 2023 to the latest month; the threshold, window, span and placebos are fixed here, and the test is reported on 2023 onward.
plan.test: The statistic at fifteen minutes standardized by its distribution at placebo thresholds from ten to sixty five minutes; one sided normal p value.
plan.title: The fifteen minute line
